title: Addus HomeCare to Participate in Upcoming March Investor Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Addus HomeCare's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://addus.gcs-web.com/node/14466/pdf)


FRISCO, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mar. 9, 2026-- Addus HomeCare Corporation (Nasdaq: ADUS), a provider of home care services, today announced its participation at the following investor conferences:


- **Oppenheimer 36th Annual Healthcare MedTech & Services Conference** on Monday, March 16, 2026. Dirk Allison, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and Brian Poff, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer will participate in a virtual presentation at 9:20 a.m. Eastern Time / 8:20 a.m. Central Time on Monday, March 16, 2026.
- **KeyBanc Capital Markets Healthcare Forum** on Tuesday, March 17, 2026. Dirk Allison, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and Brian Poff, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer will participate in a virtual presentation at 11:15 a.m. Eastern Time / 10:15 a.m. Central Time on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.


In connection with the virtual conferences, there will be a live broadcast and replay of the Company’s presentation available under the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website,[www.addus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Faddus.com%2F&esheet=54441778&newsitemid=20260309892496&lan=en-US&anchor=www.addus.com&index=1&md5=e6c091277623ebd42b030f64524fad6f) . An online replay will also be available on the Company’s website for one month, beginning approximately one hour following the conclusion of the live broadcast.


**About Addus HomeCare**


Addus HomeCare is a provider of home care services that primarily include personal care services that assist with activities of daily living, as well as hospice and home health services. Addus HomeCare’s consumers are primarily persons who, without these services, are at risk of hospitalization or institutionalization, such as the elderly, chronically ill and disabled. Addus HomeCare’s payor clients include federal, state, and local governmental agencies, managed care organizations, commercial insurers, and private individuals. Addus HomeCare currently provides home care services to approximately 62,500 patients and consumers through 262 locations across 23 states. For more information, please visit[www.addus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.addus.com&esheet=54441778&newsitemid=20260309892496&lan=en-US&anchor=www.addus.com&index=2&md5=179aa2bbde4663cd479c0c39f8efc285) .
